title: China's Coal Production Hits Five-Year Low
section_path: China's Coal Production Hits Five-Year Low
section_path_text: China's Coal Production Hits Five-Year Low
summary:
Main
By Jeffrey Landsberg
As we discussed in Commodore Research's most recent Weekly China Report, China's coal production in July totaled 343.2 million tons. This is down month-on-month by 37.7 million tons (-10%), down year-on-year by 37.8 million tons (-10%), and marks the lowest production since October 2021. Remaining significant is that the last time that there was any year-on-year growth was back in June 2025.
